title: Participant selection in the SSBBA program of the Kedah State Zakat Board
core_idea: Examine and outline the process and criteria used by the Kedah State Zakat Board (SSBBA program) to select asnaf participants, framing human capital characteristics within Islamic principles and analysing secondary Islamic scholarship and reports under the ZPEU framework to propose a structured selection approach for socio-economic development.
tldr: A qualitative case study of the Kedah State Zakat Board’s SSBBA program that investigates participant selection criteria and human-capital characteristics grounded in Islamic principles, using secondary sources within the ZPEU framework to inform a structured selection approach for asnaf beneficiaries.
